name: hopium-family
description: hopium.family — social trading super-app (web + iOS + Android, one codebase)

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui && tsc --noEmit -p apps/mobile
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @hopium/mobile && eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern packages scripts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run export:web
